sentences.en: Don't make any noise or you'll scare the birds away.
sentences.zh: 别出声，否则会把鸟儿吓跑。

sentences.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
sentences.zh: 如果我是只鸟，就能飞到你身边。

sentences.en: The hunter aimed a shotgun at the flock of birds.
sentences.zh: 猎人对准一群飞鸟扣动了扳机。

senses.zh: 猎鸟；观察研究野鸟Bird伯德 (男子或女子名, 亦作Byrd)
